title: EgoSurgHands: An Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Dataset & Benchmark for Open Surgery Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.27101v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Surgical skill assessment, AR guidance, and robot learning from demonstration all benefit from 3D tracking of the surgeon's hands, yet no surgical dataset offers real egocentric articulated 3D hand pose. We introduce EgoSurgHands, a benchmark for real-captured egocentric hand pose estimation in open surgery training on synthetic pads. Captured with multi-sensor glasses, it contains 41,909 training hand-instance rows across 55 procedure recordings and 9,476 human-validated evaluation rows across 13 held-out recordings, spanning 13 tasks, 3 glove colors, and 4 trainees from first-year medical student to third-year resident. Each frame carries a multi-sensor stack: intrinsics, hand landmarks with per-hand confidence, timestamps, and eye gaze, plus SLAM extrinsics where SLAM succeeded. translated_title: EgoSurgHands：面向开放手术训练的第一人称视角3D手部姿态数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 手术技能评估、AR增强现实引导以及从示范中学习的机器人训练都受益于对外科医生手部的3D跟踪，然而目前尚无手术数据集能够提供真实采集的第一人称视角关节式3D手部姿态。我们提出了EgoSurgHands，这是一个用于在合成手术垫上进行开放手术训练的真实采集第一人称手部姿态估计基准。该数据集通过多传感器眼镜采集，包含来自55段手术录像的41,909条训练手部实例数据行，以及来自13段独立保留测试录像的9,476条经人工验证的评估数据行，涵盖13个手术任务、3种手套颜色，以及从一年级医学生到三年级住院医师共4名受训者。每一帧均携带多传感器数据堆栈：相机内参、带有每只手置信度信息的手部关键点、时间戳和眼动注视数据，并在SLAM成功运行的情况下附带SLAM外参。评估标签结合了传感器融合的伪真值、对每一帧的人工交叉审查、外科医生对标记疑难案例的裁定，以及一个独立的……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个提供真实采集的第一人称视角3D手部姿态标注的开放手术训练数据集与基准EgoSurgHands，可支持手术技能评估、AR引导和机器人示范学习。
en_tdlr: EgoSurgHands is the first benchmark dataset with real-captured egocentric articulated 3D hand pose annotations for open surgery training, enabling surgical skill assessment, AR guidance, and robot learning from demonstration.
